sn30.3:1.2: aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn30.3:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 4
sn30.3:1.4: Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti vācāya dvayakārī manasā dvayakārī ||
sn30.3:1.6: Aṇḍajā supaṇṇā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā ti || || 5
sn30.3:1.8: Ahovatāham kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā aṇḍajānam supaṇṇānam sahavyatam upapajjeyyanti || ||
sn30.3:1.9: So kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānam sahavyatam upapajjati || || 6
sn30.3:1.10: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānam sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 1-3
